### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We will see faster decisions, stronger public services, better crisis response, and greater capacity to solve complex problems.

2. We believe superintelligent AI will transform government performance. If it is built within the next 20 years, every government will gain powerful new abilities to analyze evidence, coordinate action, reduce waste, and deliver results.

3. Superintelligent AI will make every government more effective if it is built within the next 20 years. We should prepare public institutions now to harness its power for better administration, faster responses, and stronger services.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. It will give public institutions unprecedented capacity to analyze evidence, anticipate crises, coordinate services, reduce waste, and carry out decisions with speed and precision. From local agencies to national administrations, governments will be better equipped to solve problems, deliver essential programs, enforce laws, and respond to the people they serve. We should prepare now so institutions can integrate these systems responsibly and translate their capabilities into stronger public administration. The result will be governments that work better, act faster, and accomplish more for everyone.
